chat.t: Celebrating 100K Subscribers! ★Huge Vlog Guest Casting Call★
♡Feelharmony Monastery♡ Urgent call for someone to appear in special content!

o: Feelharmony Monastery? That's where all those idol nuns are, right?

chat.t: Seeking 1 guest to experience the Sacred Union Ritual! First★come★first★served!
Open your heart—and your chest—and come receive Harmonix's blessing!

o: Chest? Union? No way I'm missing this!!

chat.t: Your application has been received!
11 PM, at Feelharmony Monastery!
Whew, my camera broke, so I couldn't film today either!

o: …I told you we should check if it's actually broken first.

chat.t: Well, it's okay! Don't worry about it too much > <
I mean, sure, something precious broke, but I wanted to try a new camera anyway!

o: …? Then isn't it actually a good thing I broke it?

chat.t: Th-That's not what I meant...!

o: Great, now you get to buy a new camera.

chat.t: Hehe;;;
Anyway, come by tomorrow! Got it?
It's definitely going to be fun, so make sure you come!
I've already ordered a new camera, so help me get ready for the next shoot

lines.t: Late at night, I hurried to Feelharmony Monastery.
In front of the Feelharmony Monastery
Welcome! Welcome to Feelharmony Monastery!
Gasp! Gasp!
I almost ran late trimming my nails.
Your nails? Oh! Trying to make a good impression on Harmonix?!
You came prepared! I like that!
Of course I did.
Then... shall we get down to business?
Eek! What are you doing?!
What do you think? I'm getting ready for the Sacred Union Ritual!
Huh? I mean, yes, but... why are you taking your clothes off?!!
Isn't that necessary for union?
Uh... Oh!! You mean you're changing into a Feelharmony outfit for the ritual!!
O-Okay! Then here... take this spare nun outfit for now!!
No, I'm not suddenly planning to cross-dress...
...Looks like there was some kind of misunderstanding.
Anyway, I should introduce myself first. I'm Lucia!
I was a little shocked when you suddenly took off your pants, but... well, with that kind of showmanship, you pass!
Of course I'd pass.
Great. Then let's start filming!
Where are we going now?
Hehe, shouldn't this kind of shoot be done somewhere private?
Inside the Feelharmony Monastery
True. But somewhere empty...
Now, let's see. Can you help me set up the camera first?
Sure, why not.
It's heavier than it looks, so be careful...!
Aaaah! My FX3 Limited Edition!
FX... what?
I bought that to celebrate reaching 100k followers!
...Is it expensive?
Must've been secondhand. It looked so worn out, I couldn't tell.
Waaah! I worked day and night to afford that!
I slept with it in my arms, and even took it with me when I went tanning! It's my most precious baby! *Sob*...
Why on earth would you bring a camera with you to go tanning?
Anyway! What are you gonna do about it?! Do you have any idea how much this cost?!
Looks like it's worth a couple of pennies at best.
...Come here. Let me whisper it to you.
(whisper whisper)
Why are you using such an expensive camera in the first place?!

Well, that's how my charm gets captured perfectly!
You have no idea how important the camera is for live content!
The weight of the crown is no joke! If you're going to lead followers, gear like this is essential!
Hmm, I guess so.
Aww, that half-hearted reaction hurts my feelings...
Anyway! What are you going to do about it?!
Sigh... I don't have any money, you know?
Lie down and refuse to take responsibility.
What?! You can't just do that!
Well, who told you to hand such an expensive camera to me?
And besides, it's not like it shattered. It's just a little bumped and scratched.
Take it to a repair shop later. Who knows, maybe it's in better shape than you think.
Aaaah, no! That camera is super sensitive!
Even the slightest bump means it needs recalibration...
At this rate, even if we call a professional, it could take months!
I don't care, I'm broke. I can pay you back with my body, but I can't give you any cash.
...Wait, pay back with your body?
...Huh?
Hehehe, I just got a great idea!
Alright, pay me back with your body.
But you have to do exactly as I say, okay?!
...I feel like I just got played.

chat.t: The camera is here! Great, now it's time for the Ritual of Unity!
Make sure to wash up thoroughly before you come!
Oh, by the way,
I forgot to buy it! We need some supplies.
We need some clear gel cream...
You... know what it's used for, right?
Great, bring that along! Let's meet in front of the cathedral this time!
Bye!
So, did you have fun today? Hehe.

o: I felt like my skin was burning off.

chat.t: I'm glad you had fun!
But... you know there's still more to do, right?
The Sacred Union Ritual has two stages! We've only finished stage one!
The next ritual is going to be even more fun!

o: ...It's actually going to be fun, right?

chat.t: Yep! Just trust me!

lines.t: Inside Feelharmony Cathedral
Hmm, I'm really looking forward to this.
What are you grinning about? Tell me too!
Wouldn't you like to know.
Well, whatever. You brought the supplies I asked for, right?
Of course. Here it is.
Huh...? I've never seen this brand before...
Well, it should be fine! Let's head to the set!
Feelharmony Monastery Counseling Room
This is... the set?
Yep! The cathedral and the monastery are connected, and this is the monastery's counseling room! Great facilities, right?
There's a sofa... and oh, a cot in the corner too.
But why is there a bed in a counseling room?
Huh? Aren't beds supposed to be here?
Even the prayer rooms have beds.
...I suppose they do.
Truly an exemplary monastery.
Here! Put these sunglasses on first!
What's this? Highly dark-tinted sunglasses?
Now, strip!
I-I mean... only your top, not your pants, okay?
Alright, now lie down here on your stomach!
(My back... is this leading to a massage first? That's pretty thrilling in its own way.)
Perfect, stay right there!
I'll... be ready soon, so...
(At this rate, I'm going to end up a devout believer who visits the monastery every single day.)
Hmm... well, it should be fine! Alright, applying the cream now!
(Ooh, so we're starting with the back. Maybe she'll rub it with those huge things of hers...)
This should do it! Alright, rolling the camera!
Is everyone having a wonderful day, my Feelharmony Angels?
Today's vlog topic is... none other than!
(What the... Are we doing this in front of the camera, with everyone watching?)
(Well, well, I never expected to make my debut like this...)
It's... tanning!
So many Angels ask about the secret behind Lucia's skin tone!
Of course, I go to tanning salons regularly, but... on hot days like this, I prefer natural tanning!
(...Something feels terribly off.)
This counseling room here at Feelharmony Monastery gets great sunlight, making it the perfect tanning spot!
For any Angels visiting the monastery, let's go tanning together when the weather is nice!
Now, if we adjust the window like this...
(Aaaargh! What the hell! My back is suddenly burning...!)
Our guest is absolutely loving it too!
Isn't that right, Mr. Guest?
I'm. Having. So. Much. Fun. Hahaha...
And that was how I ended up with my back roasted like a piece of barbecue meat...
...Lucia's revenge for her FX-whatever camera was truly terrifying.

chat.t: The Sacred Union Ritual, Part 2!
Want a little spoiler?
Today is... the Baptism of Purification!

o: I'm quite confident when it comes to spraying.

chat.t: Yay!☆ I can't wait!!
Though we'll be changing up the method a little bit this time!
So head over to Vermont Plaza!!
Thanks for your hard work!
Filming is finally done!

o: Yeah, you worked hard getting all wet
There were some disappointing parts, but I enjoyed it in my own way
Anyway, I still don't get how this is supposed to be a ritual of unity

chat.t: We're unifying with Harmonix's energy, you know?
Hehe, anyway, I think the water gun was a pretty good idea
Don't you think you have a talent for content planning?
Awesome! Let's plan the next content together! When should we do the next shoot?

o: No doubt it'll just be another video of you playing with me

chat.t: Did I do that?
The other user has left the chat.
Wait a minute! >< You still have to pay back for the camera

lines.t: Vermont Plaza

I came to meet Lucia again today.
What on earth is this Baptism of Purification in the plaza supposed to be...?
You're early today!
Because they say the early bird... gets the tastiest treat?
Great! Now, let's go receive Harmonix's blessing!
Lucia's Baptism Vlog starts now!
Still, doing this in the plaza right in front of everyone... that's pretty bold.
Just sprinkling water on the face and head like a traditional baptism is so old-fashioned!
This kind of thing needs to be exciting and eye-catching!
So how exactly are you going to draw more attention?
Exactly! Getting completely soaked from head to toe—that's the trend for purification rituals now!
Soaking the whole body...? To have that much volume...
The camera will be focused on me, so we'll keep going until I'm completely drenched!
Oh... just imagining it is pretty stimulating.
You ready for this?
Of course. Who do you think I am?
Nice! I like that attitude!
Alright, take this!
...? What's this device?
The remote control for the plaza fountain!
...? Don't tell me, a remote vibr—
I tried pressing the switch, but Lucia didn't show any reaction.
Huh? Why are you staring at me like that?
...Lucia. Just to make sure.
Are you talking about the fountain in the center of the plaza, or a different fountain?
Uh... there shouldn't be any other fountain...?
Ah! I get it! You're surprised because it didn't work!
Don't worry! The signal is just weak, so you have to get a bit closer for it to work!
Anyway, let's start filming now!
...Tch. Fine. Give me just a moment then.
I need to go prep one more thing.
...? Sure, go ahead!
Hello again, my Angels!
Today, we're doing a special Baptism of Purification vlog here at Vermont Plaza!
Alright, let's begin!
Ah! What the... that's not the fountain—
Hehehehe, this is revenge for playing with me.
Getting wet from the fountain or getting wet from my water gun, it's all the same anyway!!
Hey, what are you talking about!
Ah!! N-Not there... that's a bit of a sensitive spot...
Ah, my bad, my bad. It's just that area wasn't fully wet yet.
(Should I pretend it was an accident and enjoy this as much as I can... hehe)
Mmmh!
Wh-Why do you keep aiming for my chest...!!!
(Well, who told you to walk around with your chest wide open like that?)
Haa... I feel kind of weird...
It's alright, Lucia.
It's a completely natural reaction.
Ah! L-Look... the number of likes on the vlog is suddenly skyrocketing!
Huh...? Maybe I should stream the Baptism of Purification more often...?
Even better.
It's proof that everyone is enjoying this situation.
I-I guess so...Ah!
But don't you think this is a bit too weird to be called a purification ritual...?
I know all about it, Lucia.
You're enjoying this too.
